peopleAlsoAsk.question: Who is Savneet Singh CEO of Par Technology?
peopleAlsoAsk.title: Savneet Singh - PAR Technology | FS/TEC Speaker - Informa Connect
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Savneet Singh is the President & CEO of PAR Technology Corp., and President of ParTech, Inc. Mr. Singh is a partner of CoVenture, LLC, a multi-asset manager with funds in venture capital, direct lending, and cryptocurrency. He has served as a partner of CoVenture since June 2018.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Who is the CEO of Par Technology Corporation?
peopleAlsoAsk.title: About - PAR Technology
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Savneet Singh is the President & CEO of PAR Technology Corp. (NYSE: PAR), a global leader in restaurant technology. Since taking the helm, he has led PAR's transformation from near bankruptcy to a market cap of over $2.75 billion.
